title: an `autoload` prefix may take one segment from a directory name, every segment is checked, and an autoloaded file declares the name the map finds it by
scope:
the prefix of an explicit `autoload` declaration — a `{..}` segment read off the disk,
and the shape every segment must have — the namespace an autoloaded file must declare, and the
`missing` section of `nvs check --autoload-map`. It does not change `autoload discover`, how a
root is probed, or that a root which does not exist is allowed.
dependsOnText:
[0061](0061.md) for the map and the one-declaration rule, [0062](0062.md) for the
exact on-disk spelling.
